terms.comment: paulum cinnamōmī is our easy way to say “a pinch of cinnamon,” without implying an exact measure.

phrases.latin: Nimis acida est? Paulum banānae addāmus.
phrases.english: Is it too sour? Let’s add a little banana.

phrases.latin: hoc erat in vōtīs: modus agrī nōn ita magnus, hortus ubi et tēctō vīcīnus jūgis aquae fōns et paulum silvae super hīs foret
phrases.english: this is what I prayed for: a piece of land not so very big, with a garden, a spring of running water near the house, and a bit of woodland above them

sources: Horace from the Latinitas loci collection (loci-horatius).
